The previous question on the motion to recommit was ordered pursuant to clause 2(b) of rule XIX.
Mrs. Dingell moved to recommit to the Committee on Natural Resources. (text: CR H5401)
The previous question was ordered pursuant to the rule.

dimensions.assessment: Affects commercial lobster and crab fishermen operating in the Northeast, as well as the National Marine Fisheries Service.
dimensions.evidence: American lobster and Jonah crab fisheries to utilize existing and innovative fishing gear technologies

dimensions.assessment: Extends a regulatory timeline by seven years, delaying the implementation date for new fishing gear requirements.
dimensions.evidence: extend the time period for which certain regulations concerning the North Atlantic right whale are effective

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue changes are stated or implied.
Amends a single deadline within the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023.
dimensions.evidence: Section 101 of division JJ of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023... is amended by striking '2028'... and inserting '2035'

dimensions.assessment: Extends the deadline effect for seven years until 2035.
dimensions.evidence: striking '2028' each place it appears and inserting '2035'

missing_information: Economic impact estimates on commercial fisheries or environmental impact estimates on the North Atlantic right whale due to the deadline extension.
importance_detail.rationale: Extends a regulatory compliance deadline by seven years (from 2028 to 2035) for the National Marine Fisheries Service regarding whale protection gear rules for lobster and crab fisheries.
